result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers recommend headings plus space and explain why cards and rules add weight without meaning. A gives a much more concrete spacing system: 16px within sections, 40–48px between them, 40px above and 16px below headings, values kept on a set scale, plus implementation tips. B's ranges are vaguer and could overlap (up to 24px between fields against 32px before a section). Both cover when to switch methods well, and A's squint test and Preferences guidance make it slightly more useful. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers give the same clear recommendation (headings plus space) and say when cards or rules would be better. B explains more about why space reduces clutter, since it covers the semantic role of cards and rules. Its spacing guidance is also more concrete: within-section vs between-section ratios, asymmetric heading spacing, a spacing scale and toggle row gaps. A is solid but less detailed on spacing relationships.
